Hah. This won't work because `PanacheMock` is meant to mock static methods. Here you're calling an instance method. Mocking this would mean mocking it for every instance, which is probably not what is expected?

I guess we can probably fix this somehow, but not sure how yet. Need to think about it.
I tried changing `fruit.persist()` to `Fruit.persist(fruit)` and updating the mock to include `any(Fruit.class)` but that didn't work either.

I'm afraid this will not be possible as the Fruit instance is creted from the serialization layer, so when it arrives inside your JAX-RS ressource it is not a mock but a real object.

I cannot see a way to workaround this.
I also tried cresting a new Fruit instance but that didn't work either

> I also tried cresting a new Fruit instance but that didn't work either

As I said, the Fruit instance will be created by the serialization layer of RESTEasy, I don't see how you can mock it.

If I used a "dto" object or something that wasn't tied to panache or
hibernate as the jaxrs input and then created a new Fruit object in the
jaxrs method - would that work or is that still the same problem?

----------
Sent from a mobile device

On Fri, Apr 2, 2021, 8:58 AM Loïc Mathieu ***@***.***> wrote:

> As I said, the Fruit instance will be created by the serialization layer

I also tried `PanacheMock.doNothing().when(Fruit.class).persist(Mockito.any(Fruit.class));` but that ended up in a ton of error saying that the mock was not complete. 

See  https://quarkusio.zulipchat.com/#narrow/stream/187030-users/topic/Need.20help.20mocking.20with.20Panache.20using.20active.20record.20pattern/near/232490543 for the exact stack trace (sorry I'm on my mobile and copy and paste isn't so easy)

This is what I meant - When I tried `PanacheMock.doNothing().when(Fruit.class).persist(Mockito.any(Fruit.class));` I got

```shell
[ERROR] org.acme.rest.FruitResourceTests.addFruit  Time elapsed: 0.28 s  <<< ERROR!
```

OK indeed. I see this is because those are real methods, they don't have `@GenerateBridge` so we don't inject the mocking bits.

Thanks for verifying!

Is that something that can be addressed in a future release?

issue.title: Support mocking PanacheEntityBase.persist static methods
issue.body:
Fixes #16182

@evanchooly @loicmathieu do you know if I need to do anything for Mongo and Kotlin too? Do they support mocking static methods too?

body: I have a PR that fixes it for the static methods. As for `entity.persist()` and other instance methods, my opinion is that you can mock them by mocking the `EntityManager` which we ultimately delegate to, but I hit a bug at https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/15092#issuecomment-814767337 which we probably have to fix.
Thanks for the updates! What are the chances of getting this into an upcoming 1.13.x release?
@FroMage FYI this is an issue with Panache Reactive as well - same issue. I assume this fix will fix that as well?
